name: Rüppell's vulture
desc: Circles on thermals and arrives fast at carcasses, stripping them within hours.
about: Rüppell's vulture, also called Rüppell's griffon vulture or Rüppell's griffon, a species of vulture named after Eduard Rüppell, is a large, resident bird of prey, mainly native to the Sahel region…
